task: publish a post to social media (Instagram, X, Facebook, TikTok): compose the post — text, photo, or clip — add caption and tags, preview how it will look to the audience, publish, and verify it is live; complete when the published post is visible on the profile or feed. Surface pinned: a social platform's posting flow on app or web. Variants: direct messages, editing the video/photo content itself, and growth or algorithm advice do not belong.
